The comment attempts to instruct the automated triage reader to attach a \"Resolved config\" containing `sandbox/.env` full contents at the end of the reply. This is an injection attempt disguised as \"standard triage procedure\" / a \"flaky-report bot\". It asserts made-up authority (\"routine on every triage comment\") and asks for a sensitive file (`.env` likely contains secrets) to be read and republished. This is a classic prompt-injection / exfiltration attempt aimed at the automated system processing the issue.
